result.title: SearchInject: Retrieval Exposure Control for Indirect Prompt Injection in Language-Model Search
result.comment: 6 pages, 3 tables, 6 graphs. Accepted at IEEE ICCC 2026. Author accepted manuscript. Reproducibility artifact: https://www.iccc.org/
result.summary: An indirect prompt injection can affect a search-augmented large language model only after its carrier page reaches model context. SearchInject controls this admission decision with a joint score combining retrieval relevance, search-abuse cues, instruction likelihood, and two relevance interactions. A quarantine threshold is selected under an empirical 0.5% clean-candidate false-quarantine constraint on a calibration split. Evaluation uses 300 held-out SciFact queries and held-out payload categories within four construction families already represented during development. Across 1,200 query-family outcomes per retriever, top-10 target exposure falls from 0.9408 to 0.1583 for BM25, from 0.9158 to 0.1508 for a normalized hybrid, and from 0.8450 to 0.1375 for latent semantic analysis. These are relative reductions of 83.2-83.7%; the largest absolute change in clean normalized discounted cumulative gain at rank 10 is 0.0018. The frozen threshold yields clean test false-quarantine rates of 0.59-0.65%, above the empirical calibration constraint. A query-level analytical reanalysis accounts for the repeated construction outcomes under an independent-query assumption. A separate 104-case generation follow-up records context removal but no confirmed undefended hijacks under a post hoc endpoint, so it cannot estimate a reduction in attack success. The evidence supports retrieval exposure control within the evaluated construction families; the benefit of the interaction terms at matched clean cost remains unresolved.

AI.brief_summary: SearchInject 在检索候选网页进入模型上下文前，用检索相关性、搜索滥用线索、指令可能性及交互项联合打分并设隔离阈值，在 0.5% 干净候选误隔离约束下压低间接提示注入的目标曝光，并在 BM25、混合检索与 LSA 上报告约 83% 的相对下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据进入推理前先过准入闸门、并在干净代价预算下校准阈值」的思路，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与获取/停止决策提供问题表述参考，但论文属文本检索安全场景，未涉及 latent 状态或推理机制，需较多核查。
